MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The step drill bits felt like a strong next purchase because they add a hole-enlarging capability alongside my twist drills and could help prepare sheet metal for rivet nuts.",
    "The 1/4-20 machine screws could work with my UNC rivet nuts, while the M6 socket screws could extend my smaller metric assortment, provided their lengths fit the job.",
    "The magnetic hooks fit my interest in organizing and mounting tools, assuming I have a suitable steel surface."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The pressure gauge needs a specific pressure range and connection that I have no current reason to use; owning inspection and measuring tools does not create that need.",
    "The long lag screws and fixed-size self-tapping screws require particular jobs, while another wood screw assortment overlaps with supplies I already have.",
    "Five rolls of duct tape and four large trash cans exceed my current needs, even though repair and workshop supplies are relevant to me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any screw, even though thread, dimensions, material being joined, and existing supplies determine whether I need it.",
    "My workshop activity seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest specialized equipment and bulk supplies without a clear use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My rivet nuts, installation tool, drill bits, and measuring tools make complementary hole preparation and compatible fastening supplies especially useful.",
    "I distinguish between adding a useful capability and buying more of something I already own; frequent purchases do not mean I need duplicate assortments or large quantities."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my fastening and workshop interests, but only some connected those interests to compatible parts, useful new capabilities, and quantities I would actually use."
}
